gate_type: VALIDATION gate — ASSY Functional & UI Validation before R3 (R2V). NO product code change.
objective: Confirm by functional + browser/UI evidence that the rebuilt canonical ASSY experience at the R2 head (4fc81e72780fe14ba5532407fdc8113b44385617) still preserves the previously accepted rich ASSY simulation configuration/capabilities and the agreed six-independent-sub-line behaviour, now running on ONE canonical TIPA RuntimeSession. Validation only: launch/navigation/identity, Frame A six live sub-lines, Frame B 2D physical parity (12 positions, WIP motion, AP04 join, rendered==positions[] truth), interaction/inspector parity, lifecycle (STEP/RESET/NEW ATTEMPT/REPLAY + SH-WTP switch isolation), mandatory visible six-line independence (hold one / five continue / release resumes) and visual sanity with defect classification.
explicit_non_objectives: No new test configuration to make the gate pass
No automatic correction of any defect found (SA authorization required)
stop_conditions: Any BLOCKER or MAJOR functional/visual defect is found
Validation shows the rich experience is not actually bound to the canonical session
A second runtime/controller/session authority is observed on the product path

acceptance_criteria.description: Launch/navigation/identity: shell and rich UI share one workspace/run/scenario/profile; opening rich UI does not advance time or create another runtime
Frame A: exactly six live sub-lines with independent state under one parent run
Frame B: 2D layout, 12 accepted positions, visible WIP movement, AP04 join + genealogy, rendered == positions[] truth
Inspector/quality/genealogy read models + retained OPS-03/OPS-04 thin bindings behave; selection is presentation-only
Lifecycle: STEP same session; RESET same run_id baseline; NEW ATTEMPT fresh run_id; REPLAY deterministic; SH-WTP switch isolation
Six-line independence visible: hold ASSY-SL03, five continue, Frame B frozen, release resumes
Visual sanity: readable Frame A/B, no major clipping, understandable WIP motion, usable identity/controls, no stale inspector, no severe console errors; defects classified
Regressions (R1, R2, OPS-03/04, G22, G25/G26, full suite) and complete canonical baseline green at the pushed head
